schema.name: string, the publication's name
schema.topics: non-empty list of lowercase topic tags matched against the article's tags
schema.submission_url: string, where writers submit (from the official guidelines)
schema.editorial_review: must be true: a human editor reviews submissions
schema.accepts_ai_assisted_with_disclosure: true | false | "unknown" (false entries are never offered; unknown entries are flagged)
schema.source_url: string, the official submission guidelines page the entry was verified against
schema.verified_at: ISO date a human verified the entry against source_url
